blocks.content: Structured revision and consistent practice of key concepts are essential for success in competitive examinations.

items: Pay special attention to definitions, dates, and key terminology in standard reference material.
Direct questions are frequently framed from factual data and analytical comparisons.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Thoroughly review core concepts and fundamental facts for competitive exams.
Focus on high-yield topics frequently asked in preliminary and main examinations.
Practice previous year questions (PYQs) to understand exam patterns and question trends.
